episodes.title: Operation Strix
episodes.summary: Twilight is an agent that works for WISE, Westalis's intelligence agency, and he is tasked with investigating Desmond, who is in Ostania and planning to start a war. Twilight disguises himself as the psychiatrist Loid Forger and adopts a girl named Anya so that he can enroll her into the prestigious Eden College to get closer to his target. Unbeknownst to him, Anya is actually a telepath who can read people's minds. One day, members of a mafia group that is after Twilight kidnaps Anya. Loid realizes that he needs to reconsider his priorities and...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Secure a Wife
episodes.summary: Civil servant Yor Briar has a secret identity: an assassin named the Thorn Princess. Lately, single women had been suspected of being spies, which was making Yor nervous. Meanwhile, Loid was searching for someone to play Anya's mother so they could attend the interview at Eden College. He just happens to run into Yor at a boutique. Anya reads Yor's mind and finds out that she's an assassin and tries to get Loid to ask Yor to play her mother.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Prepare for the Interview
episodes.summary: Yor moves in with Loid and Anya. Now that they are a family, they need to prepare for the interview. But Loid realizes with how Anya and Yor currently are, the interview probably won't go well. In order to make sure they all understand how an upper-class family should be, Loid decides that they should all go out as a family. They go to the theatre and a museum, but it's just not clicking with Anya and Yor. Twilight begins to lose hope, but...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Prestigious School's Interview
episodes.summary: The day they had been preparing for has finally arrived! The Forgers are fully prepared and head to the interview. As soon as they enter the school grounds, Loid feels someone watching them. All of the applicants were being observed from the shadows by the instructors of the academy. The exam had already begun. Housemaster Henderson, who would be grading their performance, kept a keen eye on how the Forgers were acting and seeing if they were truly worthy of the prestigious Eden College.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Will They Pass Or Fail?
episodes.summary: The day that Eden College would announce the applicants that successfully got into the school had finally arrived, but Anya's number is not listed. The Forgers fall into the depths of despair but are greeted by Henderson. He praises them for their interview and tells them that Anya is at the top of the waiting list. Three days later, they find out that Anya got into the school! Franky comes over to celebrate with the Forgers and they all agree to reward Anya for working so hard. What Anya asks for...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Friendship Scheme
episodes.summary: Anya's uniform is finished. Loid has to go to a WISE strategy meeting, so he has Yor pick up the uniform as he heads to the safehouse. At the meeting, he finds out that Anya will have to receive 8 Stellar Stars and become an Imperial Scholar at Eden College in order for him to successfully complete Operation Strix. Meanwhile, Anya is very excited about getting her new uniform. But there are always criminals on the lookout for wealthy students from Eden College and Anya gets targeted by a group of hoodlums.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Target's Second Son
episodes.summary: Anya ends up with a Tonitrus Bolt after she hit Damian Desmond. Sadly, this causes her to stand out for the wrong reasons in class which depresses her, but she ends up friends with Becky, and school becomes a little more fun. She also tries to apologize to Damian for hitting him, but just can't seem to get the words out. For the sake of Operation Strix, Loid disguises himself as someone who works at the school and tries to help Anya reconcile from the shadows, but...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Counter-Secret Police Cover Operation
episodes.summary: Ostania's counterintelligence agency and national security bureau conducts spy hunts and keeps surveillance on its citizens to maintain peace within the country. They are also called the Secret Police and are feared. Yor's younger brother Yuri actually belongs to the Secret Police and is hunting down spies while keeping this a secret from Yor and others around him. One day, he suddenly shows up at the Forger residence. The Forgers, who are full of secrets, and Yuri, who has a secret identity, come face to face!Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Show Off How In Love You Are
episodes.summary: In order to prove to Yuri that they are actually a married couple, Loid and Yor are supposed to kiss. Loid is willing to get this done immediately for the sake of Operation Strix, but Yor can't do this sober, so she ends up downing a bunch of wine and gets drunk.  Yuri sees his sister this way, also gets drunk, and is unable to make rational decisions anymore...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: The Great Dodgeball Plan
episodes.summary: A rumor spreads amongst the first graders at Eden College saying that if they do well in their next PE class, they will get rewarded with Stella Stars. Anya is determined to get a Stella Star, so she trains with Yor. Thus begins the dodgeball match between Cecile Hall and Wald Hall! Anya and her classmates are determined to win, but they are faced with the giant, Bill Watkins.Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Stella
episodes.summary: In order for parents to attend one of the social gatherings at Eden College, their children need to be Imperial Scholars, but Anya hating to study makes this rather difficult. Loid then comes up with a plan to get Anya to get Stella Stars by doing community service rather than with her academics. But when she ends up volunteering at a hospital, she continuously messes up. Later, she hears a child drowning in a pool with her telepathy and...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Penguin Park
episodes.summary: Loid is burdened with one mission after another from WISE and comes home exhausted. He then hears neighbors gossiping that he's neglecting his family. Because he can't let anyone doubt them as a family for the sake of Operation Strix, he decides to take his family to the aquarium the next day they have off to show everyone that they get along. However, he is assigned another mission from WISE while he's there, and...Source: crunchyroll

episodes.title: Project Apple
episodes.summary: As a reward for her first Stella Star Anya wants a dog and she spots one that catches her interest. Secretly she sneaks after him and unintentionally ends up in the secret hideout of a terrorist group.

episodes.title: Disarm the Time Bomb
episodes.summary: Anya sees a vision through the dog's mind that an explosion at the clock tower will kill Loid. Unable to tell Yor about this without revealing her ability, she sets out to defuse the bomb herself.

episodes.title: A New Family Member
episodes.summary: Anya insists that the family takes in the dog. But when she goes to school the next day, she realizes that something very important is missing: a name. But how do you come up with a name for a dog?

episodes.title: Yor's Kitchen / The Informant's Great Romance Plan
episodes.summary: Yor takes cooking lessons from Camilla and Loid has to help Franky with his date.

episodes.title: Carry Out the Griffin Plan / Fullmetal Lady / Omelet Rice♡
episodes.summary: Anya tries to win Damian's favor again and offers to help him with a project in art class. But unfortunately, her artistic skills leave much to be desired.

episodes.title: Uncle the Private Tutor / Daybreak
episodes.summary: The midterms are coming up and Loid is worried about Anya's results. Yor calls Yuri, who is supposed to tutor Anya. After the exams, Loid wants to help in his own way, but in the process he meets an unexpected adversary.

episodes.title: A Revenge Plot Against Desmond / Mama Becomes the Wind
episodes.summary: A boy Anya has never noticed at school shows up and wants to take revenge on Damian as he has to leave school because of the Desmonds. Later, Yor has to deliver Anya's forgotten gym clothes!

episodes.title: Investigate the General Hospital / Decipher the Perplexing Code
episodes.summary: Anya needs to write a report about a profession that interests her, so she joins Loid at the Berlint General Hospital. Later, Anya becomes interested in deciphering codes and writes secret messages for Loid and the others.

episodes.title: Nightfall / First Fit of Jealousy
episodes.summary: Agent Nightfall is out to take Yor's role as Loid's wife. She visits the Forgers' home when Loid and Anya are away and tries everything to drive Yor away.

episodes.title: The Underground Tennis Tournament: The Campbelldon
episodes.summary: Loid and Fiona play in an underground tennis tournament in order to get their hands on a painting that contains a secret message. But they soon realize that there is something fishy going on in these matches.

episodes.title: The Unwavering Path
episodes.summary: The tennis match continues and the opponents resort to all sorts of other nasty tricks to win against Loid and Fiona. To make matters worse, another obstacle gets in their way right after the match.

episodes.title: The Role of a Mother and Wife / Shopping With Friends
episodes.summary: Loid realizes that Yor is burdened by the matter concerning Fiona and decides to take her out. But when he wants to talk to her about the issue, only more misunderstandings arise. Later, Becky rents out a whole store and starts her own little fashion show with Anya.

episodes.title: First Contact
episodes.summary: The day of the semi-annual get-together for Imperial Scholars has come and Loid tries contact with Donovan Desmond through Damian. But Damian is not sure whether his father even wants to meet him.

episodes.title: Follow Papa and Mama
episodes.summary: Yor is shot in the butt while on a mission and looks miserable when she gets home. Loid mistakes her very apparent miserable mood as her being unhappy with their marriage of convenience and offers to take her out on a date.

episodes.title: Bond's Strategy to Stay Alive / Damian's Field Research Trip
episodes.summary: Bond sees an ominous future and believes that it's Yor's food that's going to cause it. In order to change this fate, Bond leaves the house to search for Loid! Henderson orders Damian, Emil, and Ewen to go on a field research trip with Mr. Green.

episodes.title: Mission and Family / The Elegant Bondman / The Heart of a Child/Waking Up
episodes.summary: Yuri is doing great at his job with the Secret Police. His assignment today is to investigate a former newspaper reporter suspected of selling articles slandering Ostania to Westalis. Anya's favorite cartoon hero Bondman shows off his elegant spy moves!!

episodes.title: The Pastry of Knowledge / The Informant's Great Romance Plan II
episodes.summary: Eden's legendary dessert finally appears! In order to obtain the macaroons that supposedly can make you into an Imperial Scholar if eaten, Anya and her friends race to get to them first.

episodes.title: Plan to Cross the Border
episodes.summary: On a mission as Thorn Princess and using her job as city hall as a cover, Yor is tasked with protecting the only survivors of the Gretcher family, Olka and her son, and helping them escape to a different country by traveling on a cruise ship.

episodes.title: The Fearsome Luxury Cruise Ship
episodes.summary: After boarding the cruise ship, Yor began her duty as bodyguard to Olka and her son. Meanwhile, Yor's superior, Matthew, finds an assassin who is after Olka and her son.

episodes.title: Who Is This Mission For?
episodes.summary: Loid tries to pick out souvenirs that will make him look like a fun and happy dad so he can cheer Anya up. Meanwhile, Yor was facing off with Sickle-and-Chain Barnaby.

episodes.title: The Symphony Upon the Ship / Sis's Herb Tea
episodes.summary: The deck is filled with passengers enjoying the fireworks show. Anya and Loid were also enjoying the fireworks. Meanwhile, Yor's mission finally reaches its climax. She tries to help Olka and the others escape, but they are surrounded by assassins!

episodes.title: The Hand That Connects to the Future
episodes.summary: Due to the movements the State Security Service members were making, Loid finds out that there was a bomb on the ship. Loid leaves Anya at the daycare in a hurry then disguises himself as a State Security Service member to take care of the bomb.

episodes.title: Enjoy the Resort to the Fullest / Bragging About Vacation
episodes.summary: The morning after the attack from the assassins and the bomb scare, the cruise ship arrives at the resort island. Loid and Anya meet up with Yor and the three enjoy a family vacation!

episodes.title: Berlint in Love / Nightfall's Daily Life
episodes.summary: Becky is very excited about a romantic drama on TV, so she heads over to the Forgers' place to see Loid, who she fell in love with instantly after seeing his picture. Becky aggressively pursues Loid.

episodes.title: Part of the Family
episodes.summary: As Bond is on a walk with Loid, he has a premonition of an accident, so he tries to stop it, but is scolded by Loid. He then sees a vision of a building going up in flames and a sobbing girl standing in front of it.

episodes.title: Berlint Panic | The Informant and Nightfall
episodes.summary: The Forgers enjoy a day off while Nightfall hires Franky to help her on a mission.

episodes.title: Avoid Getting Tonitrus Bolts | ■■■■'s Memories I
episodes.summary: Anya's class must avoid getting Tonitrus Bolts and we get a glimpse into someone's past.

episodes.title: ■■■■'s Memories II
episodes.summary: Loid recalls what happened in the past that led him to where he is today.

episodes.title: Behind the Scandal | The Path to an Imperial Scholar
episodes.summary: WISE agents protect an opera singer and Henderson gives Anya tips on becoming an Imperial Scholar.

episodes.title: The Mommy-Friends Scheme
episodes.summary: Yor goes out shopping and happens to save someone quite unexpected.

episodes.title: White Jealousy | The Eden College Busjacking Incident
episodes.summary: A doctor's jealousy gets Loid into some trouble at the hospital and Anya's class goes on a field trip.

episodes.title: The Red Circus
episodes.summary: A bus carrying Anya's class is busjacked by some terrorists.

episodes.title: Take Down the Busjacker
episodes.summary: Henderson gets on the bus to give the children food and water. Billy remembers his purpose in life.

episodes.title: Austin's Troubles | A Normal Mixer | Moon Landing
episodes.summary: Mr. Austin is having nightmares after the busjacking incident and Yor goes out with her coworkers.

episodes.title: Extreme Level 3 Situation
episodes.summary: Twilight and Yuri get an emergency summons from their respective agencies.

episodes.title: Battle to the Death in the Sewers
episodes.summary: The WISE agents and the State Security Service agents clash in the sewers.

episodes.title: A World Where We Cannot Survive
episodes.summary: The battle in the sewers reaches its conclusion and Loid tries to remedy his relationship with Yor.
